# Isaiah Chapter 32 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 20 verses]*

*Righteous king; fools exposed; complacent women warned; Spirit poured out; wilderness becomes garden*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** The fruit of righteousness will be peace; its effect will be quietness and confidence forever. This chapter righteous king.

*-- LOGOS*
